summary.description: Short explanation of what target was found and why.

monitor_index.description: Monitor index for coordinate actions, matching the prompt's screenshot metadata. Null for actions without coordinates.

x.description: X coordinate relative to the screenshot image.

y.description: Y coordinate relative to the screenshot image.

text.description: Text for type_text or paste_text. Use paste_text for terminal commands, long text, or punctuation-heavy text.

amount.description: Scroll wheel clicks. Positive means down, negative means up.

key.description: Keyboard key for press_key actions. Named keys: enter, escape, tab, backspace, delete, space, arrow_up, arrow_down, arrow_left, arrow_right, home, end, page_up, page_down, f1-f12. OS-aware shortcuts that map to the correct modifier for the operating system named in the prompt: select_all, copy, paste, cut, undo, redo, save, find, new_tab, close_tab. Modifier combos joined with '+', for example cmd+l, ctrl+shift+t, alt+f4; cmd and primary mean Command on macOS and Control on Windows/Linux, while ctrl is always the literal Control key. Use enter for Return/Enter. For ordinary text-field replacement, use select_all before paste_text. For terminal prompt replacement, use control_a then control_k before paste_text. Null for non-key actions.

window.description: Window title (preferred) or application name for focus_window actions, copied exactly from the visible windows list in the prompt. Null for all other actions.
